items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1960-03-29
items.q: Buddy Johnson played trombone in that band.

ctx.x: Oh, that broke up long. Buddy Johnson played trombone in that band. Yeah, that was a good band, boy. Manuel Perez. Let me see who played. Who played with Manuel? Bunk. A little buddy called Bunk. What did he play?
Trumpet. I know who he is. Dark fellow.
